content.text: Based on the interest "摄影学习，关注实际拍摄方法、成像原理与不同条件下的调整，不关注器材促销或摄影师私生活", I filtered out all "市场观察" articles (camera packages/promotions/celebrity endorsement) and "专题观察" articles (exhibitions, artist biographies, viewing experience), keeping only the "条件与原理" (imaging principles + condition applicability) and "操作记录" (hands-on shooting method) articles. With 29 such candidates across all 10 topics and 4 scenes, the working set is sufficient; I selected 20 covering every topic with a mix of both content types.
